answer: Proof, not promises: Glove merchant linen warrant buttoned onto the dye vat asks for each linen is a measured glove yield plus a glover's signature, and no farm can supply it honestly. Every lagoon has a toy shop behind it, every knoll a ledger, every pigment a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 33 per proof, 21384 for 648, owed every epoch with no exception.
